facts.text: Serve the snacks when Robert and Sam go hunting deer in Times Square.
facts.why: A review describes Neville's hunting trips with Sam to a Times Square overrun by deer, so the cue stands.
A review of the film says corn grows abundantly in Neville's allotment in Central Park.

facts.text: Central Park charred corn chicken bowls
facts.why: Same review: Neville's corn grows in his Central Park allotment.
Neville recites a whole Shrek scene aloud along with the video while Anna and Ethan watch him, and says 'I like Shrek.' It is not to nobody.
facts.fix: Neville quoting Shrek along with the TV

vibe.verdict: A believable ration sheet for a man alone in New York, but it uses only a few of the film's best-known moments and the food is generic.
missing: Neville reciting Shrek along with the video (Anna and Ethan watch)

ideas: Swap 'Pan-fried steak' note 'Cut one for Sam, the best dog in New York' for a Shrek night line: 'Say every line along with the video.'
Swap 'Moka pot espresso' for 'South Street Seaport noon coffee' with the note 'Broadcast on all AM frequencies, nobody came.'
Rename 'Neville's shelter pantry rice pudding' to 'Fred's hello pudding' to use the mannequin he says hello to.
Swap the printed 'ALL AREAS' badge text for 'IMMUNE' so the badge ties to his blood and the cure.
